{
  "object_type": "参数化管道弯头 profile_object",
  "assumptions": [
    "对象为等截面圆形管道弯头，中心线位于局部XY平面。",
    "默认弯曲角度为90度，允许45、90、135度。",
    "bend_radius 表示管道中心线弯曲半径。",
    "管道两端为垂直于中心线的平面开口，暂不建模法兰、焊缝和保温层。",
    "保留 Archicad 标准参数 A、B 作为兼容性尺寸参数，主要几何由指定参数驱动。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "沿圆弧中心线生成空心圆管截面。",
    "外径由 pipe_od 控制，内径由 pipe_od - 2 * pipe_thk 派生。",
    "弯曲角度由 bend_angle 控制，限制为45、90或135度。",
    "弯曲半径由 bend_radius 控制，定位管道中心线圆弧。",
    "弯头两端保留真实开口，不封闭内外圆环端面以外的虚假实体。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "圆环管道截面：外半径 pipe_od / 2，内半径 pipe_id / 2。",
    "弯曲中心线：半径 bend_radius、角度 bend_angle 的平面圆弧。",
    "端部截面：由TUBE路径首尾截面形成。",
    "可选简化端部标识：仅在2D脚本中表达中心线和管道外轮廓。"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：Length，标准兼容宽度参数，默认1000 mm。",
    "B：Length，标准兼容深度参数，默认1000 mm。",
    "pipe_od：Length，管道外径，默认114.3 mm。",
    "pipe_thk：Length，管道壁厚，默认6.3 mm。",
    "bend_angle：Angle，弯曲角度，默认90°，允许45/90/135°。",
    "bend_radius：Length，管道中心线弯曲半径，默认152.4 mm。",
    "mat_pipe：Material，管材材质，默认通用金属材质。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "尺寸：A、B、pipe_od、pipe_thk、bend_radius。",
    "弯曲控制：bend_angle。",
    "材质：mat_pipe。",
    "建议将A、B设为兼容或隐藏参数，避免与管道专用参数产生歧义。"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [
    "pipe_id = pipe_od - 2 * pipe_thk。",
    "pipe_ro = pipe_od / 2。",
    "pipe_ri = pipe_id / 2。",
    "bend_angle_rad = bend_angle * π / 180。",
    "arc_len = bend_radius * bend_angle_rad。",
    "end_offset = bend_radius * (1 - COS(bend_angle_rad))。",
    "end_span = bend_radius * SIN(bend_angle_rad)。",
    "path_segments = MAX(4, CEIL(bend_angle / 15))。",
    "section_segments = 24，必要时可扩展为性能参数。"
  ],
  "command_candidates": [
    "TUBE：主几何命令，因管道截面需要沿真实弯曲圆弧路径连续扫掠。",
    "FOR/NEXT：按path_segments生成圆弧路径点，避免手工展开重复路径。",
    "MATERIAL：将mat_pipe应用于管道几何。",
    "PROJECT2：2D脚本中生成基础投影。",
    "HOTSPOT2：提供角度、半径和端部方向的可编辑热点。",
    "不使用REVOLVE作为主命令：弯头是沿圆弧路径扫掠的管件，而非绕固定轴形成的完整旋转体。",
    "REVOLVE仅作为备选实现：若目标版本TUBE语法或截面闭合规则不稳定，可将弯头近似拆分为圆环弧段旋转体，但需要额外处理管壁内外轮廓。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "Master脚本先计算pipe_id、内外半径、弯曲角度和路径分段数。",
    "3D脚本使用低点数圆弧路径生成TUBE，首尾路径点按GDL要求设置为phantom点。",
    "截面采用闭合空心圆环多边形，外圆和内圆轮廓方向相反以表达管壁。",
    "路径点按bend_radius和bend_angle计算，保证45/90/135度均由参数驱动。",
    "所有路径生成和截面点生成使用FOR/NEXT循环。",
    "TUBE属于高阶命令，理由是管壁截面必须沿弯曲中心线连续移动；简单CYLIND无法表达弯曲管段。",
    "所有ADD、ROT和变换命令必须在同一局部范围内用DEL精确配平；优先使用NTR记录栈深度。",
    "为避免首轮复杂度过高，先采用圆弧路径和24段圆截面，后续再增加平滑度或性能参数。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "使用PROJECT2 3, 270, 2作为非空基础投影。",
    "补充手工中心线圆弧或弯头外包络线，便于平面识别。",
    "根据bend_angle绘制45/90/135度对应的弯头符号。",
    "使用HOTSPOT2显示两端控制点、弯曲半径控制点和角度控制点。",
    "2D脚本不重复构造完整实体，仅表达投影、中心线和参数编辑符号。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "定义所有参数的类型、默认值、分组和描述。",
    "将bend_angle限制为45、90、135三个离散值，防止产生未验证角度。",
    "校验pipe_thk > 0 且 pipe_id > 0。",
    "校验bend_radius > pipe_ro，避免弯曲内侧自相交。",
    "校验pipe_od、pipe_thk和bend_radius为正值。",
    "保证每个声明参数最终被Master脚本或3D脚本引用。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "按尺寸、弯曲控制、材质分组显示参数。",
    "bend_angle使用下拉选项45°、90°、135°。",
    "显示pipe_od、pipe_thk、bend_radius和计算得到的pipe_id。",
    "对非法壁厚和过小弯曲半径显示警告或自动限制输入。",
    "材质控件使用Material类型选择器。"
  ],
  "material_strategy": [
    "mat_pipe作为唯一主要管材材质参数并应用于TUBE主体。",
    "默认使用通用金属或钢材质。",
    "未来可扩展内壁、外壁或端面独立材质，但首版不增加未被要求的材质参数。",
    "避免将材质写死在3D脚本中，确保mat_pipe实际驱动几何显示。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "原点作为弯曲起点基准。",
    "首端热点控制第一段切线方向。",
    "沿弯曲半径方向设置可拖拽热点，驱动bend_radius。",
    "设置角度热点，拖拽后将角度吸附到45、90或135度。",
    "设置末端热点用于识别弯头终点和方向。",
    "热点仅改变参数或局部显示，不破坏对象变换栈。"
  ],
  "validation_checks": [
    "2D脚本非空，包含PROJECT2或有效2D图元。",
    "所有变换命令与DEL数量严格配平。",
    "path_segments和section_segments均由参数或派生参数控制。",
    "bend_angle仅能取45、90、135度。",
    "pipe_id = pipe_od - 2 * pipe_thk 必须大于零。",
    "bend_radius必须大于管道外半径，避免弯曲内侧相交。",
    "TUBE路径首尾phantom点、截面闭合和轮廓方向符合目标Archicad版本语法。",
    "每个参数均实际驱动Master、3D、2D或材质逻辑。",
    "检查弯头端面方向、内壁连续性和不同角度下的几何完整性。",
    "检查45、90、135度及最小合法弯曲半径下无自相交或空几何。"
  ],
  "knowledge_sources": [
    "core.planning_contract：profile_object构件规划约定。",
    "core.generation_discipline：2D非空、变换栈配平、循环参数化和参数接线要求。",
    "core.command_selection：TUBE用于真实弯曲路径扫掠，REVOLVE仅用于真实旋转体。",
    "profile_object：剖面/放样构件的3D、2D和热点策略。",
    "TUBE、PROJECT2、ADD_DEL相关GDL命令知识片段。"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "TUBE是高阶命令，路径点、phantom点和空心截面闭合规则可能因Archicad版本存在语法差异。",
    "弯曲半径过小会造成内侧自相交或三角面翻转。",
    "section_segments和path_segments过高会影响2D PROJECT2投影性能。",
    "REVOLVE不能直接处理带孔轮廓，因此不适合作为首选空心弯头实现。",
    "GDL角度单位、三角函数和局部坐标方向必须在目标版本中验证。",
    "端部法向和截面旋转方向若处理不当，可能导致TUBE截面扭转。"
  ]
}

{
  "object_type": "Window",
  "assumptions": [

    "open_state和sash_angle均实际影响开启扇几何或2D表达。",

    "archetype.window",

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 1.00 ! Stair width
Length B = 3.36 ! Total run, derived
Length ZZYZX = 2.04 ! Total rise, derived
Integer stair_steps = 12 ! Number of treads
Length riser_h = 0.17 ! Riser height
Length tread_w = 0.28 ! Tread width
Length tread_thk = 0.04 ! Tread thickness
Boolean has_riser = 1 ! Include risers
Material mat_tread = 1 ! Tread material
Material mat_riser = 1 ! Riser material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Stair Master Script

_steps = MAX(1, INT(stair_steps))
_riser = MAX(riser_h, 0.001)
_tread = MAX(tread_w, 0.001)
_thk = MAX(tread_thk, 0.001)

_total_run = _steps * _tread
_total_rise = _steps * _riser

B = _total_run
ZZYZX = _total_rise

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! Stair 2D Script

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

FOR i = 1 TO _steps
    LINE2 0, i * _tread, A, i * _tread
NEXT i

LINE2 A / 2, 0, A / 2, B

IF has_riser = 1 THEN
    FOR i = 1 TO _steps
        LINE2 0.08, i * _tread, A - 0.08, i * _tread
    NEXT i
ENDIF

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
]
! Stair 3D Script

TOLER 0.001

MATERIAL mat_tread

FOR i = 1 TO _steps
    ADD 0, (i - 1) * _tread, i * _riser - _thk
    BLOCK A, _tread, _thk
    DEL 1
NEXT i

IF has_riser = 1 THEN
    MATERIAL mat_riser

    FOR i = 1 TO _steps
        ADD 0, i * _tread - _thk, (i - 1) * _riser
        BLOCK A, _thk, _riser
        DEL 1
    NEXT i
ENDIF

END

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl
]
! Stair Parameter Script

VALUES "A" RANGE [0.30, 3.00]
VALUES "stair_steps" RANGE [1, 100]
VALUES "riser_h" RANGE [0.001, 0.50]
VALUES "tread_w" RANGE [0.001, 1.00]
VALUES "tread_thk" RANGE [0.001, 0.20]
VALUES "has_riser" 0, 1

LOCK "A"
LOCK "B", "ZZYZX"

HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

RECT2 -col_bf / 2, -col_hw / 2, col_bf, col_hw
RECT2 0, -plate_w / 2, plate_t, plate_w

_row_span_2d = (bolt_rows - 1) * bolt_row_spacing
_col_span_2d = (bolt_cols - 1) * bolt_col_spacing

_r2 = 0 ! Fixed: 预先赋值，避免循环变量未定义警告

FOR _r2 = 1 TO bolt_rows
    FOR _c2 = 1 TO bolt_cols
        ARC2 plate_t / 2 + (_r2 - 1) * bolt_row_spacing - _row_span_2d / 2, (_c2 - 1) * bolt_col_spacing - _col_span_2d / 2, bolt_d / 2, 0, 360    ! [LINTER-FIXED RULE-002]
    NEXT _c2

    bend_radius * (1 - COS(bend_angle + path_step)),

        pipe_ri * SIN(section_angle)

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_body
TOLER 0.001

_base_h = ZZYZX * 0.08
_top_h = ZZYZX * 0.08
_body_h = MAX(ZZYZX - _base_h - _top_h, ZZYZX * 0.20)
_seg_h = _body_h / MAX(1, seg_count)
_profile_n = 2 * seg_count + 3

PUT 0, 0, 1
PUT base_d / 2, _base_h, 1

FOR i = 1 TO seg_count
    _t = (i - 0.5) / seg_count
    _center_d = base_d + (top_d - base_d) * _t

    IF MOD(i, 2) = 1 THEN
        _turn_factor = 1.08
    ELSE
        _turn_factor = 0.92
    ENDIF

    _mid_z = _base_h + (i - 0.5) * _seg_h
    PUT (_center_d * _turn_factor) / 2, _mid_z, 1

    _end_t = i / seg_count
    _end_d = base_d + (top_d - base_d) * _end_t
    _end_z = _base_h + i * _seg_h
    PUT _end_d / 2, _end_z, 1
NEXT i

PUT 0, ZZYZX, 1

HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0
HOTSPOT 0, 0, ZZYZX
HOTSPOT A / 2, 0, 0
HOTSPOT 0, B / 2, 0
HOTSPOT base_d / 2, 0, _base_h
HOTSPOT top_d / 2, 0, ZZYZX - _top_h

ROTX 90
REVOLVE_ _profile_n, 360, mat_body, mat_body, mat_body, 63, GET(NSP)
DEL 1

END

    BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, ZZYZX

    NEXT _r

        ADD plate_t, -stiff_w / 2, _stiff_z0

    NEXT _s
RETURN

Length A = 0.600 ! Width

Material mat_shelf = 0 ! Shelf material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.01 THEN A = 0.01
IF B < 0.01 THEN B = 0.01
IF ZZYZX < 0.02 THEN ZZYZX = 0.02
IF n_shelves < 2 THEN n_shelves = 2
IF shelf_thk < 0.001 THEN shelf_thk = 0.001
IF ZZYZX < n_shelves * shelf_thk THEN shelf_thk = ZZYZX / n_shelves

_safe_n_shelves = MAX(2, INT(n_shelves))
_side_thk = shelf_thk
_inner_w = MAX(0, A - 2 * _side_thk)
_inner_h = MAX(0, ZZYZX - _safe_n_shelves * shelf_thk)
_shelf_gap = _inner_h / (_safe_n_shelves - 1)

_host_wall_thk = WALL_THICKNESS
_host_wall_h = WALL_HEIGHT
_seo_mode = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
RESOL 12

MATERIAL mat_body
BLOCK _side_thk, B, ZZYZX
ADDX A - _side_thk
BLOCK _side_thk, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

MATERIAL mat_shelf
FOR i = 1 TO _safe_n_shelves
    ADDZ (i - 1) * (_shelf_gap + shelf_thk)
    BLOCK _inner_w, B, shelf_thk
    DEL 1
NEXT i

END

    _i = 0    ! Fixed: initialize loop variable before use
    FOR _i = 1 TO _safe_count
        _u = (_i - 0.5) / _safe_count
        _zdir = 1 - 2 * _u
        _radial = SQR(MAX(0, 1 - _zdir * _zdir))
        _azimuth = 137.507764 * (_i - 1)
        _xdir = _radial * COS(_azimuth)
        _ydir = _radial * SIN(_azimuth)

        LINE2 node_r / 2 * _xdir, node_r / 2 * _ydir, (node_r / 2 + strut_length) * _xdir, (node_r / 2 + strut_length) * _ydir
    NEXT _i

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER _compat_tolerance

MATERIAL node_material
SPHERE _node_rad

MATERIAL strut_material

_i = 0    ! Fixed: initialize loop variable before use
FOR _i = 1 TO _safe_count
    _u = (_i - 0.5) / _safe_count
    _zdir = 1 - 2 * _u
    _radial = SQR(MAX(0, 1 - _zdir * _zdir))
    _azimuth = 137.507764 * (_i - 1)
    _xdir = _radial * COS(_azimuth)
    _ydir = _radial * SIN(_azimuth)
    _tilt = ACS(_zdir)

    ROTZ _azimuth
    ROTY _tilt
    CYLIND strut_length, _strut_rad
    DEL 3
NEXT _i

END

            ENDIF
        ENDIF

        ROTZ _edge_rot

HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

IF show_2d_nodes = 1 THEN

        _x = _i * _panel_w
        CIRCLE2 _x, B / 2, chord_d / 2
    NEXT _i
ENDIF

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001

ADD 0, B / 2, 0

FOR _i = 1 TO panel_count
    _x1 = (_i - 1) * _panel_w
    _x2 = _i * _panel_w

    _z1 = ZZYZX * (1 - ABS(2 * _x1 / A - 1))
    _z2 = ZZYZX * (1 - ABS(2 * _x2 / A - 1))

    ! Lower chord
    _x1m = _x1
    _y1m = 0
    _z1m = 0
    _x2m = _x2
    _y2m = 0
    _z2m = 0
    _len = SQR((_x2m - _x1m) * (_x2m - _x1m) + (_y2m - _y1m) * (_y2m - _y1m) + (_z2m - _z1m) * (_z2m - _z1m))
    IF _len > 0.000001 THEN
        MATERIAL mat_chord
        GOSUB "DrawMember"
    ENDIF

    ! Upper chord
    _x1m = _x1
    _y1m = 0
    _z1m = _z1
    _x2m = _x2
    _y2m = 0
    _z2m = _z2
    _len = SQR((_x2m - _x1m) * (_x2m - _x1m) + (_y2m - _y1m) * (_y2m - _y1m) + (_z2m - _z1m) * (_z2m - _z1m))
    IF _len > 0.000001 THEN
        MATERIAL mat_chord
        GOSUB "DrawMember"
    ENDIF

    ! Alternating diagonal web
    IF MOD(_i, 2) = 1 THEN
        _x1m = _x1
        _y1m = 0
        _z1m = 0
        _x2m = _x2
        _y2m = 0
        _z2m = _z2
    ELSE
        _x1m = _x1
        _y1m = 0
        _z1m = _z1
        _x2m = _x2
        _y2m = 0
        _z2m = 0
    ENDIF

    _len = SQR((_x2m - _x1m) * (_x2m - _x1m) + (_y2m - _y1m) * (_y2m - _y1m) + (_z2m - _z1m) * (_z2m - _z1m))
    IF _len > 0.000001 THEN
        MATERIAL mat_web
        GOSUB "DrawMember"
    ENDIF
NEXT _i

DEL 1
END

"DrawMember":
    _dx = _x2m - _x1m
    _dy = _y2m - _y1m
    _dz = _z2m - _z1m

    IF ABS(_dz) > 0.000001 THEN
        _angle = ATN(_dx / _dz)
        IF _dz < 0 THEN
            _angle = _angle + 180
        ENDIF
    ELSE
        IF _dx >= 0 THEN
            _angle = 90
        ELSE
            _angle = -90
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

    ADD _x1m, _y1m, _z1m
    ROTY _angle
    CYLIND _len, chord_d / 2
    DEL 2
RETURN

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 1.00 ! Compatibility width
Length B = 1.00 ! Compatibility depth
Length ZZYZX = 1.00 ! Compatibility height
Length pipe_od = 0.1143 ! Pipe outside diameter
Length pipe_thk = 0.0063 ! Pipe wall thickness
Angle bend_angle = 90 ! Bend angle: 45, 90, or 135 degrees
Length bend_radius = 0.1524 ! Centerline bend radius
Material mat_pipe = 0 ! Pipe material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A <= 0 THEN A = 1.00
IF B <= 0 THEN B = 1.00
IF ZZYZX <= 0 THEN ZZYZX = 1.00
IF pipe_od <= 0 THEN pipe_od = 0.1143
IF pipe_thk <= 0 THEN pipe_thk = 0.0063
IF pipe_thk >= pipe_od / 2 THEN pipe_thk = pipe_od * 0.25
IF bend_radius <= pipe_od / 2 THEN bend_radius = pipe_od
IF bend_angle < 67.5 THEN bend_angle = 45
IF bend_angle >= 67.5 AND bend_angle < 112.5 THEN bend_angle = 90
IF bend_angle >= 112.5 THEN bend_angle = 135

pipe_id = pipe_od - 2 * pipe_thk
pipe_ro = pipe_od / 2
pipe_ri = pipe_id / 2
bend_angle_rad = bend_angle * PI / 180
arc_len = bend_radius * bend_angle_rad
end_offset = bend_radius * (1 - COS(bend_angle))
end_span = bend_radius * SIN(bend_angle)
path_segments = MAX(4, INT(bend_angle / 15 + 0.999))
section_segments = 24
path_step = bend_angle / path_segments
path_count = path_segments + 3
section_count = section_segments * 2

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
PEN 1
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 end_span, end_offset
HOTSPOT2 0, bend_radius
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
LINE2 0, 0, end_span, end_offset
LINE2 0, 0, 0, bend_radius
LINE2 0, bend_radius, end_span, end_offset
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! TUBE_ is used because the pipe wall follows a true circular bend path.
MATERIAL mat_pipe
TOLER 0.005

! Phantom path point before the first real centerline point.
PUT 0,
    -bend_radius * SIN(path_step),
    bend_radius * (1 - COS(path_step)),
    0

FOR i = 0 TO path_segments
    path_angle = i * path_step
    PUT bend_radius * SIN(path_angle),
        bend_radius * (1 - COS(path_angle)),
        0
NEXT i

! Phantom path point after the last real centerline point.
PUT bend_radius * SIN(bend_angle + path_step),
    bend_radius * (1 - COS(bend_angle + path_step)),
    0

! Outer circular section, oriented normal to the first tangent.
FOR j = 0 TO section_segments - 1
    section_angle = j * 360 / section_segments
    PUT 0,
        pipe_ro * COS(section_angle),
        pipe_ro * SIN(section_angle)
NEXT j

! Inner circular section, reverse winding to define the pipe wall.
FOR j = section_segments - 1 TO 0 STEP -1
    section_angle = j * 360 / section_segments
    PUT 0,
        pipe_ri * COS(section_angle),
        pipe_ri * SIN(section_angle)
NEXT j

TUBE_ path_count, section_count, 1, 0, mat_pipe, GET(NSP)
END

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.020 THEN A = 0.020
IF B < 0.020 THEN B = 0.020
IF ZZYZX < 0.020 THEN ZZYZX = 0.020
IF bracket_thk < 0.002 THEN bracket_thk = 0.002
IF rail_d < 0.010 THEN rail_d = 0.010
IF bolt_count < 1 THEN bolt_count = 1
IF arm_length < 0.020 THEN arm_length = 0.020
IF arm_length <= bracket_thk THEN arm_length = bracket_thk + 0.001

_plate_thk = bracket_thk
_plate_h = MAX(B, ZZYZX)
_bolt_spacing = B / (bolt_count + 1)
_bolt_d = MAX(bracket_thk * 0.8, 0.006)
_rail_r = rail_d / 2
_saddle_clearance = MAX(rail_d * 0.08, 0.002)
_arm_section = MAX(bracket_thk * 2.5, 0.020)
_rail_axis_z = B / 2 + _rail_r + _saddle_clearance
_effective_arm = MAX(arm_length, MAX(bracket_thk + 0.001, 0.020))

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl]
VALUES "A" RANGE [0.020, 2.000]
VALUES "B" RANGE [0.020, 2.000]
VALUES "ZZYZX" RANGE [0.020, 2.000]
VALUES "arm_length" RANGE [0.020, 1.000]
VALUES "bolt_count" RANGE [1, 6]
VALUES "bracket_thk" RANGE [0.002, 0.100]
VALUES "rail_d" RANGE [0.010, 0.100]
VALUES "show_rail_reference" 0, 1

LOCK "A"
LOCK "B"
LOCK "ZZYZX"

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
PEN 1
MATERIAL mat_bracket
TOLER 0.001

! 墙面安装底板
ADDX -A / 2
BLOCK A, _plate_thk, _plate_h
DEL 1

! 水平外伸支架臂
ADD -_arm_section / 2, _plate_thk, B / 2 - bracket_thk / 2
BLOCK _arm_section, _effective_arm, bracket_thk
DEL 1

! 末端扶手承托块
ADD -_arm_section / 2, _plate_thk + _effective_arm - _rail_r - _saddle_clearance / 2, _rail_axis_z - bracket_thk / 2
BLOCK _arm_section, rail_d + _saddle_clearance, bracket_thk
DEL 1

! 固定螺栓
MATERIAL mat_bolt
FOR i = 1 TO bolt_count
    ADD A / 2, -_bolt_d, i * _bolt_spacing
    ROTX 90
    CYLIND _bolt_d, _bolt_d / 2
    DEL 2
NEXT i

! 局部圆形扶手参考段
IF show_rail_reference = 1 THEN
    MATERIAL mat_rail
    ADD -0.010, _plate_thk + _effective_arm, _rail_axis_z
    ROTY 90
    CYLIND A + 0.020, _rail_r
    DEL 2
ENDIF

END

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl
PEN 1

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, 0
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, _plate_thk + _effective_arm

RECT2 -A / 2, 0, A / 2, _plate_thk
LINE2 -_arm_section / 2, _plate_thk, -_arm_section / 2, _plate_thk + _effective_arm
LINE2 _arm_section / 2, _plate_thk, _arm_section / 2, _plate_thk + _effective_arm
CIRCLE2 0, _plate_thk + _effective_arm, _rail_r

FOR i = 1 TO bolt_count
    _bolt_x = (i / (bolt_count + 1)) * A - A / 2
    CIRCLE2 _bolt_x, _plate_thk / 2, _bolt_d / 2
NEXT i

IF show_rail_reference = 1 THEN
    LINE2 -A / 2, _plate_thk + _effective_arm, A / 2, _plate_thk + _effective_arm
ENDIF
